name: I-78 Western New Jersey (Warren / Hunterdon)
study_limits_note: Study section per the INRIX pull: I-78 from the PA-NJ state border (Delaware River, MP 0) to Charlestown Rd / Perryville Rd (Exit 12), about 13.5 miles per direction, Warren and Hunterdon counties. The crash extract currently covers only Greenwich Twp (Warren) and Bethlehem Twp (Hunterdon), about MP 3.7 to 10.4; Pohatcong Twp (MP 0 to 3.7) and Union Twp (MP 10.4 to 13) still need to be pulled.

interchanges.label: PA-NJ state border / Delaware River (I-78 Toll Bridge)
Exit 4 - Main St / CR 637 (Stewartsville, Warren Glen)
Jugtown Mountain summit (approx.; steep grade both directions)
Exit 12 - Charlestown Rd / Perryville Rd / CR 625 (NJSP Perryville Station)
East end of INRIX section (Exit 12 ramps)

note_on_zones: Zones follow the CDOT convention (interchange to interchange, adjusted for grade and visibility features). Grades, mile posts and the zone split at the Jugtown summit are placeholders until NJDOT SLD / LiDAR profile data is loaded.
